test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The diameter of a metallic sphere is 6 cm. It is melted and drawn into a wire having a diameter of the cross-section as 0.4 cm. Find the length of the wire (in meters).
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of each metallic sphere = 6 cm

Diameter of wire = 0.4 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³

Volume of cylinder (wire) = pi r²h

**Calculation:**

Radius of sphere = Diameter / 2 = 6 / 2 = 3 cm

Radius of wire = Diameter / 2 = 0.4 / 2 = 0.2 cm

⇒ Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)pi (3)³ 

⇒ Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)pi times 27 

⇒ Volume of wire = Volume of sphere

⇒ pi (0.2)²h = (4)/(3)pi times 27

⇒ pi times 0.04h = 4pi times 9

⇒ h = (4 × 9) / 0.04

⇒ h = 36 / 0.04

⇒ h = 900 cm

⇒ h = 9 m

**∴ The length of the wire is 9 m.**
